hypotheses.S0_compact_global_subspace_transfers: The rank-6 global write subspace reaches at least 0.50 downstream fidelity in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.S1_family_subspace_is_specific: The correct rank-6 family subspace beats the wrong-family median by at least 0.05 in every cell.
hypotheses.S2_family_subspace_beats_global: The correct rank-6 family subspace beats the global rank-6 subspace by at least 0.03 in every cell.
hypotheses.S3_learned_subspace_beats_random: The correct rank-6 family subspace beats a fixed random rank-6 subspace by at least 0.20 in every cell.
hypotheses.S4_subspace_transfers_ood: TinyStories rank-6 family fidelity is at least 75% of FineWeb fidelity at each layer.
hypotheses.S5_rank4_is_near_rank6: Rank-4 family fidelity is within 0.10 of rank-6 in every cell.
